en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear; reads like a 20th-century patriotic song but I cannot name an author. 'Македонско злато' as Prilep tobacco is a guess.

words_to_learn.en: gold (here probably the Prilep tobacco, my reading)

lines.en: Oh, Prilep, town, pride of Macedonia,

lines.cyr: за тебе ќе пејам, има и што да пејам.
lines.lat: za tebe ḱe pejam, ima i što da pejam.
lines.en: I will sing of you, there is much to sing about.

lines.cyr: Во тебе се раѓаат храбри Македонци,
lines.lat: Vo tebe se raǵaat hrabri Makedonci,
lines.en: In you brave Macedonians are born,

lines.cyr: Тебе ми те красат Маркови Кули,
lines.lat: Tebe mi te krasat Markovi Kuli,

lines.cyr: во тебе се роди славни Крали Марко,
lines.lat: vo tebe se rodi slavni Krali Marko,
lines.en: in you was born the famous Kraljević Marko,

lines.cyr: во песни опеан, во целиот Балкан.
lines.lat: vo pesni opean, vo celiot Balkan.
lines.en: sung in songs, in the whole Balkans.

lines.cyr: Во тебе се раѓа македонско злато,
lines.lat: Vo tebe se raǵa makedonsko zlato,
lines.en: In you Macedonian gold is born,

lines.cyr: македонско злато, што во свет го нема.
lines.lat: makedonsko zlato, što vo svet go nema.
lines.en: Macedonian gold, which the world has no equal of.

lines.cyr: Затоа се, Прилеп, со тебе гордеам,
lines.lat: Zatoa se, Prilep, so tebe gordeam,
lines.en: That is why, Prilep, I am proud of you,

lines.cyr: за тебе ќе пеам, по свет ќе те славам.
lines.lat: za tebe ḱe peam, po svet ḱe te slavam.
lines.en: I will sing of you, I will glorify you across the world.
Oh, Prilep, town, pride of Macedonia,

lines.cyr: и во тебе пукна прва пушка, граде,
lines.lat: i vo tebe pukna prva puška, grade,
lines.en: in you too the first gun fired, town,
the first gun fired against the enemies,
for Macedonia, for the Macedonian name.
